subtitle: Proving the client actually behaves as designed

eyebrow: Mocking session.post — no real network call
code:
def test_send_message_success():
    client = AIClient(api_key="test-key")
    fake_resp = MagicMock(status_code=200)
    fake_resp.json.return_value = {"content": [{"text": "Hi!"}]}

    with patch.object(client.session, "post",
                       return_value=fake_resp):
        result = client.send_message("claude-sonnet-5", [])
caption: No API key, no network, no cost — runs in milliseconds.

eyebrow: Proving the retry loop actually works
code:
with patch.object(client.session, "post",
                   side_effect=[rate_limited, success]):
    with patch("time.sleep"):
        result = client.send_message("claude-sonnet-5", [])

assert result["content"][0]["text"] == "ok"
caption: side_effect returns 429 first, then success — proving Lesson 18's loop.
